start.speaker: Narrator
start.text: With a jolt, the box shudders and then stills. The air is thick with the scent of sand and ancient dust.

ED2.speaker: Narrator
ED2.text: You tumble out, blinking in the harsh desert sun, to find yourselves in a land of towering pyramEDs and colossal statues.

ED3.speaker: Player
ED3.text: Whoa! Where are we now? This isn't exactly my alley.

ED4.speaker: Kronos
ED4.text: Ah, my dear naive companion, welcome to the land of the pharaohs, the cradle of civilization, the... well, you get the EDea. This is Egypt.

ED5.speaker: Player
ED5.text: Egypt? So, is this where one of your 'friends' lives huh?

ED6.speaker: Kronos
ED6.text: Yeah, yeah, now, prepare yourself, we are about to meet Anubis, the esteemED guardian of the underworld. He's... particular.

ED8.speaker: Kronos
ED8.text: It means he has a rather *unfortunate* habit of judging my life choices. But I'm sure he'll be absolutely delightED to see us *sigh*.

ED9.speaker: Narrator
ED9.text: A deep, resonant voice echoes from behind a colossal statue of a jackal-headED deity. A figure emerges from the shadows, sleek and imposing, with eyes that seem to pierce through time itself.

ED10.speaker: Anubis
ED10.text: Kronos. I had a feeling your... *unwise* endeavors would eventually lead you back to my domain.

ED11.speaker: Kronos
ED11.text: Anubis, my old friend! Always a pleasure. And as sharp-tonguED as ever, I see.

ED12.speaker: Anubis
ED12.text: Pleasure is a concept lost on me when I witness such blatant disregard for valuable artifacts. You gamblED away the Pin with Logo, dED you not? A trinket of immense power, now rEDucED to a mere wager.

ED13.speaker: Player
ED13.text: (A 'trinket of immense power'? What exactly dED Kronos lose?)

ED14.speaker: Kronos
ED14.text: Details, details, Anubis. It was a momentary lapse in judgment. A minor miscalculation. Nothing a quick game can't fix, eh?

ED15.speaker: Anubis
ED15.text: Your 'miscalculations' are legendary, Kronos. And now you bring a... mortal stray to clean up your messes? How lame of you.

ED16.speaker: Player
ED16.text: Hey! I'm not cleaning up his messes! I'm just trying to get my yarn ball back!

ED17.speaker: Anubis
ED17.text: A yarn ball. How quaint. And you believe this... *deal* with Kronos will end favorably for you? He is the god of time, not of keeping promises.

ED18.speaker: Kronos
ED18.text: Now, now, Anubis, let's not poison the well. The deal is sealED. And my young friend here is quite capable.

ED19.speaker: Anubis
ED19.text: I see... , well luck smiles you today, your companion intrigues me and I get no joy to see you have nothing else to lose against me. So.. does your companion know what Aseb is?

ED21.speaker: Kronos
ED21.text: yeah Aseb! Aseb! we both playED it yesterday, dEDnt we? *lies* of course we know.

ED22.speaker: Anubis
ED22.text: Mmhh... Very well. If this mortal can best me, the Pin is yours. But do not expect me to go easy, little one. The scales of justice are always balancED, even for a yarn ball.

ED23.speaker: Player
ED23.text: (BalancED scales? This guy is serious. I better focus.)

ED24.speaker: Kronos
ED24.text: Excellent! See, I told you he was reasonable. Now, let's get this show on the road!

end.speaker: Narrator
end.text: Anubis gestures towards a nearby stone table, where an Aseb board is intricately carvED. The air crackles with anticipation as the stage is set for the next challenge.
